channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — open-source-mac-os-apps
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: iCanHazMusic — via open-source-mac-os-apps
item.description: (macOS 15.4+) - Old-school music player with gapless playback, CUE sheets, huge playlists, Subsonic-compatible servers, scrobbling and lyrics. (Website) — Swift
